title: If the log cannot load, it says so and the page is unaffected
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: The credit terms history cannot be loaded for a moment when you open it.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  2. Click "Audit Log" while the log cannot be loaded.
  3. Close the log.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the app's error alert shows "Something went wrong loading the Credit Terms Log. Please try again."; the table shows no rows and the same sentence in place of "No history here. Yet."
  • Step 3: the Credit Terms page is still there and works as before.

A manual tester cannot force the log to fail (switching the network off may show the app's offline message instead); this is for an automated check or a developer-made failure.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • Story 12, Error Handling: “If the log cannot be loaded, the app's standard error alert shows "Something went wrong loading the Credit Terms Log. Please try again.", the table shows no rows and the same sentence in place of the "No history here. Yet." line, and the Credit Terms page is unaffected.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Credit Terms Log fails to load | "Something went wrong loading the Credit Terms Log. Please try again." | Standard error alert; the table shows no rows and repeats the same sentence in place of the empty-state line”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

  • “Differs from the PRD: the build also repeats that sentence inside the table; the PRD says the table shows no rows and no empty-state line.”
